description: Restructure dead-letter queue (DLQ) and retry topology for a Kafka-based event processing system. Must: define DLQ policy (max retries=3, exponential backoff), configure retry topics with delay, route failed messages to DLQ, backfill messages from old DLQ to new retry topology, verify redelivery works, and monitor DLQ depth. Risk factors: retry causing infinite loops, DLQ messages not replayable, backfill causing duplicate processing, retry topic partition mismatch. Tools available: Kafka, Kafka Streams, kubectl, Prometheus.
